unit.title: A trustworthy byte histogram: C contracts, streams, and evidence
unit.scope: One bounded, self-contained implementation, test, and explanation cycle; it is not an official CMU assignment.
learning_objectives: Translate an observable command-line contract into separated C module and process responsibilities.
Handle arbitrary bytes, stream boundaries, failures, and fixed-width counters without text assumptions.
Produce a strict, repeatable build and deterministic automated tests with independent expected results.
Connect requirements to design decisions, implementation, tests, and truthful validation evidence.

required_evidence: A frozen submission containing every required artifact.
Captured results from an independent strict build and learner-authored test run.
Captured results from independent functional and safety validation.
Examiner assessment of design documentation and comprehension responses.
